newsitem.title: USA: Citgo Louisiana coker to return 50 pct by Saturday.
newsitem.headline: Citgo Louisiana coker to return 50 pct by Saturday.

text.p: Citgo Petroleum Corp., the wholly-owned Petroleos de Venezuela SA unit, said Tuesday the downed "number two" coker unit at its Lake Charles, Louisiana refinery will return to 50 percent of capacity by Saturday.
The 62,000 barrel-per-day coker is expected to be fully back up by next Friday, Feb 21, said company spokesman Kent Young.
The coker at the 305,000 bpd refinery was shut Friday evening because of a fire, which was put out within 30 minutes by an internal fire fighting force.
Young said the cause of the fire was still being investigated.
Young added that all other operations at the plant, which also has an about 130,000 bpd of fluid catalytic cracking capacity, were running normally.
